description: Istio 1.27.3 supports Kubernetes up to 1.33 (target 1.34). Installed version 1.27.3 is in the 1.27 release line, which supports Kubernetes 1.29 through 1.33.

Istio 1.27 is end-of-life since 2026-04-07. Detected Istio version 1.27.3 via image in namespace(s): istio-legacy. Upstream support for the 1.27 release line ended on 2026-04-07. Fix: Upgrade Istio to a supported release line (newest: 1.31).

Istio 1.31 reaches end-of-life on 2027-02-28. Detected Istio in namespace(s): istio-system (1.31.1 via chart 1.31.1), shop (1.31.0 via image). Upstream support for the 1.31 release line ends on 2027-02-28. Fix: Upgrade Istio to a supported release line (newest: 1.31).
